column1: # Modules whose license go-licenses cannot classify automatically.
# go-licenses (v2.0.1, the latest release) hard-fails `save` on any package it
# classifies as "unknown", which would block notice regeneration entirely. For
# each module listed here we skip go-licenses' own detection and record the
# license ourselves: the SPDX identifier below is used in runtime-report.csv and
# the module's license file is copied into third_party_licenses/runtime/.
# Only add a module here after manually reading its license file and confirming
# the SPDX identifier. Re-verify on every version bump.
